sentences.zh: 歸太祖，授牛錄額真，隸滿洲正紅旗。

translations.literal: He submitted to Taizu, was appointed niru ejen, and was enrolled in the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He came over to Taizu, became niru ejen, and entered the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 天殺敵。

translations.literal: In the Tianming era he repeatedly killed the enemy in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Under Taizu he killed the enemy again and again in the field.

sentences.zh: 累功授三等？

translations.literal: For accumulated merit he was granted Third-rank — deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: For repeated merit he was made a Third-rank deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 命六年，從伐明，攻遼陽，敵背城而陣，葉克書衝鋒突擊；

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianming he followed the attack on the Ming; at Liaoyang the enemy drew up with the city at their backs; Yekeshu charged in assault;
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 6 he joined the Ming campaign; at Liaoyang the foe stood with the wall at their backs and Yekeshu led the charge;

sentences.zh: 攻沙嶺，先副將。

translations.literal: in the attack on Shaling he was first to reach deputy-commander rank.
translations.idiomatic: at Shaling he fought his way to deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，列十六大臣，佐正紅旗。

translations.literal: When Hong Taiji acceded, he was listed among the sixteen great ministers assisting the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: At Hong Taiji's accession he was one of the sixteen great ministers for the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，授兵部承政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tiancong he was appointed Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 5 he became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 六年，授固山額真。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed gushan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made gushan ejen.

sentences.zh: 八年八月，從貝勒代善伐明，入得勝堡；

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighth year he followed Beile Daisan in campaigning against the Ming and entered Desheng Fort;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Tiancong 8 he followed Beile Daisan against the Ming and took Desheng Fort;

sentences.zh: 略大同，下諸城堡；

translations.literal: raided Datong and reduced the surrounding forts;
translations.idiomatic: raided Datong and subdued its outworks;

sentences.zh: 西至黃河，合軍朔州。

translations.literal: westward to the Yellow River, he united his army with the force at Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: then marched west to the Yellow River and joined the army at Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月，考滿，進二等副將世職。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the merit review, he was advanced to Second-rank hereditary deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, when merits were reviewed, he rose to Second-rank hereditary deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 九年，貝勒多爾袞伐明，自大同入邊，分兵授葉克書，從貝勒多鐸屯寧遠、錦州間，綴明援師，斬明將劉應選，俘其偏裨。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Beile Dorgon campaigned against the Ming, entering the frontier from Datong; troops were detached to Yekeshu, who with Beile Dodo held the ground between Ningyuan and Jinzhou, checked Ming relief, beheaded Ming Commander Liu Yingxuan, and captured his officers.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Beile Dorgon invaded from Datong; Yekeshu was detached to join Beile Dodo between Ningyuan and Jinzhou, held off Ming relief, killed Commander Liu Yingxuan, and took his officers.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，自延慶入邊，克十二城。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed Prince Ying Ajige in campaigning against the Ming, entered the frontier from Yanqing, and took twelve cities.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he marched with Prince Ying Ajige, entered from Yanqing, and seized twelve cities.

sentences.zh: 師還，坐所部失伍及攘獲、擅殺諸罪，罷官，削世職，仍領牛錄。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was punished for his command's loss of formation, plundering booty, and unauthorized killings; he was dismissed, stripped of his hereditary office, but still led his niru.
translations.idiomatic: On the return he was cashiered for lost discipline, looting, and unauthorized killings; his hereditary rank was taken but he kept his niru.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，太宗伐朝鮮，命從承政尼堪等帥師伐。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year Hong Taiji campaigned against Korea and ordered him to follow Minister Niken and others in leading troops against —
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year Hong Taiji invaded Korea and sent him with Minister Niken against —

sentences.zh: 三？
瓦爾喀，師出會寧，擊敗朝鮮兵。

translations.literal: Walgiya; the army issued from Hoaining and defeated Korean troops.
translations.idiomatic: the Walgiya; the column left Hoaining and routed the Koreans.

sentences.zh: 十一月，從參政星訥伐卦爾察，至黑龍江，俘獲甚年，師還，上特遣大臣迎勞。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he followed Vice Minister Xingne in campaigning against the Gūlcas, reaching the Amur; captures were very many; when the army returned the khan specially sent ministers to welcome and reward them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he joined Vice Minister Xingne against the Gūlcas as far as the Amur, took a great haul of captives, and on his return the khan sent ministers to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 尋授兵部右參政。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Vice Minister of the Right in the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made right vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，授梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year he was appointed meiren ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year he became meiren ejen.

sentences.zh: 十一月，從承政索海等帥師伐索倫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he followed Minister Suohai and others in leading troops against the Solon.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he marched with Minister Suohai against the Solon.

sentences.zh: 五年四月，復任固山額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifth year he was again appointed gushan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year he was restored as gushan ejen.

sentences.zh: 七月，授牛錄章京世職。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he was granted the hereditary office of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he received the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 復從睿親王多爾袞伐明，圍錦州，與固山額真圖爾格率所部三百人為伏城西南烏欣河，捕城人出牧者。

translations.literal: Again he followed Prince Rui Dorgon in campaigning against the Ming and besieging Jinzhou; with Gushan Ejen Turgut he led three hundred men in ambush southwest of the city at the Wuxin River to seize townspeople coming out to pasture.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined Prince Rui Dorgon at Jinzhou; with Gushan Ejen Turgut and three hundred men he lay in ambush by the Wuxin southwest of the city to seize herdsmen.

sentences.zh: 敵兵千餘逆戰，葉克書馬中矢蹶，圖爾格馳救之，上馬复戰，殺敵。

translations.literal: More than a thousand enemy troops engaged them in reverse; Yekeshu's horse was struck by an arrow and fell; Turgut galloped to rescue him; he remounted and fought again, killing the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Over a thousand Ming soldiers counterattacked; Yekeshu's horse was shot down; Turgut rushed up, helped him remount, and they fought on until the foe was killed.

sentences.zh: 比還，敵潛躡其後，葉克書收兵還擊，敵潰。

translations.literal: As they were returning, the enemy secretly followed behind; Yekeshu gathered his men, turned, and struck; the enemy broke.
translations.idiomatic: On the march back the enemy crept after them; Yekeshu wheeled, hit them again, and they fled.

sentences.zh: 以功進三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: For merit he was advanced to Third-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: For this he was raised to Third-rank jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 六年九月，從貝勒杜度伐明，圍錦州，與固山額真譚泰、阿山等鑿壕環守，擊明總督洪承疇於松山。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the sixth year he followed Beile Dudu in campaigning against the Ming and besieging Jinzhou; with Gushan Ejen Tantai, Ashan, and others he dug trenches in a ring about the defenses and struck Ming Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixth year he joined Beile Dudu at Jinzhou, dug encircling trenches with Tantai and Ashan, and fought Hong Chengchou at Songshan.

sentences.zh: 十一月，從貝勒阿巴泰等伐明，師至黃崖口，葉克書與譚泰定策分兩道夾擊，入邊薄長城，麾軍先登；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he followed Beile Abatai and others against the Ming; when the army reached Huangyakou, Yekeshu and Tantai planned a two-pronged attack, entered the frontier close to the Great Wall, and commanded the troops in the first ascent;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he marched with Abatai to Huangyakou; he and Tantai split forces, came up under the Wall, and led the first climb;

sentences.zh: 攻薊州，敗明總兵白騰蛟、白廣恩諸軍。

translations.literal: in the attack on Jizhou he defeated the armies of Ming Commander Bai Tengjiao, Bai Guang'en, and others.
translations.idiomatic: at Jizhou they routed Bai Tengjiao, Bai Guang'en, and the other Ming commanders.

sentences.zh: 尋遣兵攻孟家台，陷敵，坐罷官，奪世職。

translations.literal: Soon he sent troops to attack Mengjiatai, fell into the enemy's hands, and was dismissed and deprived of his hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his detachment at Mengjiatai was trapped; he was dismissed and lost his hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 順治元年三月，世祖復命為梅勒額真，帥師駐寧遠。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Shunzhi the Shizu Emperor again appointed him meiren ejen and ordered him to command troops garrisoned at Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Shunzhi 1 the Shizu Emperor restored him as meiren ejen and stationed him at Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 四月，率步兵從入關擊李自成，身被三十一創，毀一目，戰彌厲，大破賊軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he led infantry in following the entry through the passes to strike Li Zicheng; he suffered thirty-one wounds, lost an eye, fought all the fiercer, and thoroughly broke the rebel army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he led foot soldiers through the passes against Li Zicheng, took thirty-one wounds and lost an eye, fought harder still, and shattered the rebels.

sentences.zh: 二年，從肅親王豪格略山東，賊渠十餘輩據滿家洞，憑險為巢，凡二百五十一窟，葉克書與尚書車爾格合兵搜剿，殲其渠，悉堙諸窟。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Prince Su Haoge in pacifying Shandong; more than ten rebel chiefs held Manjiadong, using the terrain as a lair—two hundred fifty-one caves in all; Yekeshu joined Minister Che Erge in searching them out; they destroyed the chiefs and buried every cave.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he followed Prince Su Haoge through Shandong; a dozen rebel chiefs held two hundred fifty-one caves at Manjiadong; with Minister Che Erge he hunted them down, killed the leaders, and sealed the caves.

sentences.zh: 以功累進二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: For merit he was repeatedly advanced to Second-rank Adahafan.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he rose to Second-rank Adahafan.

sentences.zh: 三年，授鎮守盛京總管，恩詔進三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed garrison commandant of Shengjing; on an imperial grace amnesty he was advanced to Third-rank Ashaniyahan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he became garrison commandant of Shengjing and, on an imperial grace amnesty, Third-rank Ashaniyahan.

sentences.zh: 十四年，坐昭陵總管鍾柰有罪，失不劾，罷官，奪世職。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, because Zhaoling commandant Zhongnai committed an offense and he failed to impeach him, he was dismissed and deprived of his hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he failed to impeach Zhaoling commandant Zhongnai; he was dismissed and lost his hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 十五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifteenth year.

sentences.zh: 子道喇。

translations.literal: His son was Daola.
translations.idiomatic: He left a son, Daola.

sentences.zh: 道喇以擺牙喇兵從征伐，積功至擺牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: Daola followed campaigns with the bayara troops and, for accumulated merit, rose to bayara jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: Daola campaigned with the bayara guard and rose to bayara jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，從伐明。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he followed the campaign against the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 he marched against the Ming.

sentences.zh: 五年，圍錦州，戰松山、杏山，皆有功。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he besieged Jinzhou and fought at Songshan and Xingshan, all with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year at Jinzhou, Songshan, and Xingshan he fought with distinction.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，調噶布什賢甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he was transferred to gabushixian jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he became gabushixian jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 睿親王多爾袞與李自成戰於一片石，從噶喇昂邦鄂碩當自成將唐通，通大敗。

translations.literal: Prince Rui Dorgon fought Li Zicheng at Yipianshi; following Galaa angbang Eshuo he met Li's general Tang Tong, and Tong was heavily defeated.
translations.idiomatic: At Yipianshi Prince Rui Dorgon met Li Zicheng; Daola followed Eshuo against Tang Tong and Tong was routed.

sentences.zh: 入關逐賊，戰安肅、慶都，乘勝躡擊，斬馘。

translations.literal: Entering the passes in pursuit of the bandits, he fought at Ansu and Qingdu, pressed the victory in pursuit, and took heads.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed the passes in pursuit, fought at Ansu and Qingdu, chased hard, and took many heads.

sentences.zh: 尋從固山額真葉臣略山西，至汾州，敗自成將白輝。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Gushan Ejen Yechen in pacifying Shanxi; at Fenzhou he defeated Li Zicheng's general Bai Hui.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Yechen in Shanxi and at Fenzhou beat Li's general Bai Hui.

sentences.zh: 授牛錄章京世職。

translations.literal: He was granted the hereditary office of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: He received the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 三年，從順承？

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Cheng —
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Cheng —

sentences.zh: 甚郡王勒克德渾攻荊州，擊走李錦。

translations.literal: Lekdehun of the Commandery in attacking Jingzhou and drove off Li Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Lekdehun attacked Jingzhou and drove off Li Jin.

sentences.zh: 五年，從大將軍譚泰下江西，討金聲桓，五敗賊，獲所署總兵以下。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Grand General Tantai south into Jiangxi to suppress Jin Shenghuan; five times he defeated the rebels and captured their appointed generals and below.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined Tantai in Jiangxi against Jin Shenghuan, beat the rebels five times, and seized their officers.

sentences.zh: 九年，擢正紅旗梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was promoted to meiren ejen of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he became Bordered Red Banner meiren ejen.

sentences.zh: 十年，從靖南將軍哈哈木復潮州，討郝尚久。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he followed Pacification-of-the-South General Hahamu in recovering Chaozhou and suppressing Hao Shangjiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he joined Hahamu to retake Chaozhou and crush Hao Shangjiu.

sentences.zh: 旋帥師駐荊州。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he commanded troops garrisoned at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was then stationed at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十四年，授本旗蒙古固山額真。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed gushan ejen of the Mongol Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he became Mongol gushan ejen of his banner.

sentences.zh: 十六年，從信郡王多尼平雲南，攻元江土司，克其城。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he followed Prince Xin Doni in pacifying Yunnan, attacked the Yuanjiang chieftain, and took his city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he joined Doni in Yunnan, stormed Yuanjiang, and took the town.

sentences.zh: 累功，並遇恩詔，進一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: For accumulated merit, and also on an imperial grace amnesty, he was advanced to First-rank Adahafan.
translations.idiomatic: Merit and an imperial grace amnesty raised him to First-rank Adahafan.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，以老乞致仕，徙居盛京。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kangxi, citing age he begged to retire and moved his residence to Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kangxi he retired for age and moved to Mukden.

sentences.zh: 十二年，聖祖加恩諸老臣，加太子少傅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the Kangxi Emperor showed grace to old ministers and added the title Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Kangxi honored veteran ministers and made him Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，幸盛京，召見賜坐，侍茶酒，優賚。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, on an imperial visit to Shengjing, he was summoned, granted a seat, served tea and wine, and richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the emperor visited Mukden, received him, gave him seat and wine, and lavished gifts.

sentences.zh: 二十二年九月，卒，年八十一，諡勤襄。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-second year he died at the age of eighty-one; posthumous title Qinxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the ninth month of the twenty-second year at eighty-one, posthumous name Qinxiang.

sentences.zh: 以弟之孫伊濟納襲職。

translations.literal: His younger brother's grandson Yijina inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: His brother's grandson Yijina succeeded.

sentences.zh: 葉克書次子夏穆善，第三子瑚葉，皆有戰功，授世職：夏穆善二等阿達哈哈番，瑚葉三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Yekeshu's second son Xiamushan and third son Huye all had battle merit and received hereditary offices: Xiamushan Second-rank Adahafan, Huye Third-rank Adahafan.
translations.idiomatic: Yekeshu's sons Xiamushan and Huye both won honors: Second-rank Adahafan and Third-rank Adahafan.

sentences.zh: 博爾晉，世居完顏，以地為氏。

translations.literal: Bo'erjin's clan had long dwelt at Wanyan and took the place as their surname.
translations.idiomatic: Bo'erjin's line lived at Wanyan and took the place name as their clan.

sentences.zh: 太祖初起兵，有挾丁口來歸者，籍為牛錄，即使為牛錄額真，領其眾。

translations.literal: When Taizu first raised his army, those who came over bringing households were registered as niru, immediately made niru ejen, and put in command of their people.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu first took up arms, households that submitted became niru, each leader made niru ejen over his people.

sentences.zh: 順治間，定官名皆漢語，謂之「世管佐領」。

translations.literal: In the Shunzhi period official titles were fixed in Chinese and called "hereditary assistant commandants."
translations.idiomatic: Under Shunzhi the post was given the Chinese name "hereditary assistant commandant."

sentences.zh: 博爾晉領牛錄，隸滿洲鑲紅旗，尋授侍衛。

translations.literal: Bo'erjin headed a niru enrolled in the Manchu Bordered Red Banner and soon was appointed a guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: Bo'erjin led a niru in the Manchu Bordered Red Banner and became a guardsman.

sentences.zh: 歲癸巳，太祖侵哈達，略富爾佳齊寨，博爾晉與族弟西喇布從。

translations.literal: In the year guisi Taizu invaded Hada and raided the stockade of Fu'erjiaqi; Bo'erjin followed with his clansman Xilabu.
translations.idiomatic: In guisi Taizu struck Hada and took Fu'erjiaqi; Bo'erjin went with his cousin Xilabu.

sentences.zh: 西喇布被二矢死，博爾晉拔其矢還射，殪發矢者西忒庫，為西喇布報仇。

translations.literal: Xilabu was killed by two arrows; Bo'erjin pulled out the arrows and shot back, killing the archer Xitekou, avenging Xilabu.
translations.idiomatic: Xilabu died to two arrows; Bo'erjin drew them out, shot back, and killed the bowman Xitekou to avenge him.

sentences.zh: 天命六年，授扎爾固齊。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianming he was appointed jaruguci.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 6 he became jaruguci.

sentences.zh: 城薩爾滸，命博爾晉董其役。

translations.literal: When Sarhu was being walled, Taizu ordered Bo'erjin to supervise the work.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu put him in charge of building Sarhu.

sentences.zh: 役竟，從伐明，攻瀋陽，擊敗明總兵賀世賢、陳策。

translations.literal: When the work was finished he followed the campaign against the Ming, attacked Shenyang, and defeated Ming commanders He Shixian and Chen Ce.
translations.idiomatic: When the works ended he joined the Ming war, took Shenyang, and beat He Shixian and Chen Ce.

sentences.zh: 瀋陽下，進攻遼陽，明總兵李懷信、侯世祿、蔡國柱、姜弼、董仲葵合軍五萬，屯城東南五里，左翼四旗與戰，大破之。

translations.literal: After Shenyang fell he advanced on Liaoyang; Ming commanders Li Huaixin, Hou Shilu, Cai Guozhu, Jiang Bi, and Dong Zhongkui united fifty thousand men and encamped five li southeast of the city; the four banners of the left wing engaged them and thoroughly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Shenyang taken, he pressed Liaoyang; five Ming commanders massed fifty thousand men southeast of the wall; the left wing broke them.

sentences.zh: 城兵自西門出援，博爾晉方奉命诇敵，傍城行，遂合兩紅旗兵邀擊，明兵敗，入城爭門，相蹂踐死者枕籍。

translations.literal: Troops in the city sallied from the west gate to relieve it; Bo'erjin was then under orders to scout the enemy and, marching along the wall, joined the two Red Banner forces in intercepting them; the Ming army was defeated and, rushing for the gate, trampled one another until the dead lay piled like pillows.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison sallied from the west gate; Bo'erjin, scouting along the wall, joined both Red Banners in ambush; the Ming troops broke, jammed the gate, and died in heaps.

sentences.zh: 會左翼四旗兵已登陴，畢登，遼陽亦下。

translations.literal: Meanwhile the four left-wing banners had already mounted the battlements; all ascended, and Liaoyang too was taken.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing was already on the wall; the city fell.

sentences.zh: 復分兵拔沙嶺，擊敗明廣寧援軍。

translations.literal: Again he was detached to take Shaling and defeated Ming relief from Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: He took Shaling and routed Guangning's relief.

sentences.zh: 八年，與達音布、雅希禪帥？

translations.literal: In the eighth year, with Dayinbu and Yaxishen he commanded —
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he marched with Dayinbu and Yaxishen —

sentences.zh: 博爾晉麾師伐扎魯特部，其貝勒昂安突走，達音布戰死，博爾晉與雅希禪奮進，斬昂安，俘其孥。

translations.literal: Bo'erjin led the army against the Zhalut tribe; their beile Ang'an broke and fled; Dayinbu died in battle; Bo'erjin and Yaxishen pressed forward, beheaded Ang'an, and captured his family.
translations.idiomatic: Bo'erjin attacked the Zhalut; Beile Ang'an fled; Dayinbu fell; Bo'erjin and Yaxishen charged, killed Ang'an, and took his kin.

sentences.zh: 師還，上優賚之。

translations.literal: When the army returned, the khan richly rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: On his return Taizu rewarded him generously.

sentences.zh: 十年，擢梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to meiren ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he became meiren ejen.

sentences.zh: 將兵二千伐東海虎爾哈部，收五百戶以歸，上郊迎宴勞。

translations.literal: He led two thousand men against the eastern Hūrka of the Tiger clan, brought back five hundred households, and the khan went out to the suburbs to welcome and feast him.
translations.idiomatic: He led two thousand men against the eastern Hūrka, returned with five hundred households, and Taizu met him in the suburbs with a feast.

sentences.zh: 如故。

translations.literal: As before.
translations.idiomatic: His honors stood as before.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年正月，從伐朝鮮。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Tiancong he followed the campaign against Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tiancong 1 he invaded Korea.

sentences.zh: 五月，上？

translations.literal: In the fifth month the khan —
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the khan —

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，列八大臣，領鑲紅旗，兼侍自將圍錦州，屯城西二里。

translations.literal: When Hong Taiji acceded, Bo'erjin was listed among the eight great ministers, headed the Bordered Red Banner, attended him in person as the khan himself led the siege of Jinzhou and encamped two li west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: At Hong Taiji's accession he became one of eight great ministers of the Bordered Red Banner; the khan in person besieged Jinzhou and camped two li west of the wall.

sentences.zh: 博爾晉自瀋陽帥師至，敗明兵，追至寧遠城下盡殲之。

translations.literal: Bo'erjin led troops from Shenyang, defeated the Ming army, pursued to beneath Ningyuan walls, and annihilated them completely.
translations.idiomatic: He marched from Shenyang, routed the Ming, and destroyed them under the walls of Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 先後戰功，授一等副將。

translations.literal: For successive battle merits he was granted First-rank deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: For repeated victories he received First-rank deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after.

sentences.zh: 以失敕書，子孫不得襲。

translations.literal: Because the imperial patent was lost, his descendants could not inherit.
translations.idiomatic: He lost the patent of nobility, so his line could not inherit.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，其子特錦疏請立碑紀績，部議無左證，持不可，聖祖以博爾晉事太祖，勤勞夙著，特詔許之，並追諡忠直。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi his son Tejin memorialized asking to erect a stele recording his achievements; the ministry deliberated that there was no supporting evidence and held it impossible; the Kangxi Emperor, because Bo'erjin had served Taizu with long-standing diligence, specially decreed permission and also granted the posthumous title Zhongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 3 his son Tejin asked for a merit stele; the ministry found no proof, but Kangxi, recalling Bo'erjin's service under Taizu, allowed it and posthumously named him Zhongzhi.

sentences.zh: 特錦及博爾晉孫瑪沁、曾孫康喀喇，皆有戰績。

translations.literal: Tejin, Bo'erjin's grandson Maqin, and great-grandson Kangkara all had battle records.
translations.idiomatic: Tejin, grandson Maqin, and great-grandson Kangkara all saw action.

sentences.zh: 特錦，博爾晉第四子也。

translations.literal: Tejin was Bo'erjin's fourth son.
translations.idiomatic: Tejin was Bo'erjin's fourth son.

sentences.zh: 初任牛錄額真。

translations.literal: He first served as niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He began as niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，授牛錄章京世職。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong he was granted the hereditary office of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 he received the hereditary rank of niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德五年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗帥師屯田義州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongde he followed Prince Zheng Jirhala in leading troops to garrison and farm at Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 5 he joined Prince Zheng Jirhala farming the garrison at Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 蒙古多羅特部蘇班代等降明，居杏山西五里台，使通款，上命鄭親王移師迎護。

translations.literal: Subandai and others of the Mongol Dorot tribe had surrendered to the Ming and dwelt at Wulitai five li west of Xingshan, maintaining contact; the khan ordered Prince Zheng to move his army to welcome and protect them.
translations.idiomatic: The Dorot Mongol Subandai had gone over to the Ming at Wulitai west of Xingshan; the khan sent Prince Zheng to escort them in.

sentences.zh: 明總兵祖大壽、吳三桂、劉周智屯杏山拒戰，特錦以偏師擊敗之。

translations.literal: Ming commanders Zu Dashou, Wu Sangui, and Liu Zhouzhi held Xingshan to resist; Tejin with a detached force defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Zu Dashou, Wu Sangui, and Liu Zhouzhi blocked Xingshan; Tejin's flank force beat them.

sentences.zh: 六年，從伐明，圍松山，攻寧遠，皆力戰敗敵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed the campaign against the Ming, besieged Songshan, attacked Ningyuan, and in every fight defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he fought at Songshan and Ningyuan and beat the foe each time.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，逐李自成至慶都，與梅勒額真和託合軍大敗之，進三等甲喇章京，任兵部理事官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he followed the entry through the passes, pursued Li Zicheng to Qingdu, and with Meiren Ejen Hotuo united armies in heavily defeating him; he was advanced to Third-rank jalan janggin and appointed supervising officer of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he crossed the passes, chased Li Zicheng to Qingdu, and with Hotuo shattered him; he became Third-rank jalan janggin and war-board officer.

sentences.zh: 考滿，進二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: On the merit review he was advanced to Second-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: At the merit review he rose to Second-rank jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 三年，從肅親王豪格下四川，討張獻忠，戰三水，敗其將胡敬德；

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Su Haoge into Sichuan to suppress Zhang Xianzhong; at Sanshui he defeated his general Hu Jingde;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he entered Sichuan with Prince Su against Zhang Xianzhong and at Sanshui beat Hu Jingde;

sentences.zh: 复戰禮縣，敗其將高汝礪。

translations.literal: again at Li County he defeated his general Gao Ruli.
translations.idiomatic: at Li County he routed Gao Ruli.

sentences.zh: 獻忠死西充，餘賊負山，將斷我兵後，特錦擊之走；

translations.literal: Xianzhong died at Xichong; remnant bandits held the mountains and were about to cut off the army's rear; Tejin struck and drove them off;
translations.idiomatic: When Xianzhong died at Xichong, mountain holdouts tried to cut the rear; Tejin drove them off;

sentences.zh: 又戰馬湖，破其將楊正。

translations.literal: again at Mahu he broke his general Yang Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: at Mahu he defeated Yang Zheng.

sentences.zh: 六年，從討姜瓖，略壽陽，賊犯兩藍旗分地，徇汾州，賊七千夜擊兩紅旗軍壘，特錦連擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed the suppression of Jiang Xiang, raided Shouyang; bandits invaded the Blue Banners' territory and pushed into Fenzhou; seven thousand rebels struck the Red Banner camps by night; Tejin repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year against Jiang Xiang he raided Shouyang; seven thousand rebels night-attacked the Red Banner camps and he beat them back.

sentences.zh: 平遼、遼州、榆社以次悉平。

translations.literal: Liao, Liaozhou, and Yushe were pacified in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Liao, Liaozhou, and Yushe fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢兵部侍郎，兼鑲紅旗蒙古梅勒額真，進三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to vice minister of the Board of War and concurrently Mongol meiren ejen of the Bordered Red Banner, advanced to Third-rank Ashaniyahan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he became vice minister of war and Mongol meiren ejen, and Third-rank Ashaniyahan.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢本旗蒙古固山額真、議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Mongol gushan ejen of his banner and councilor of state.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he became Mongol gushan ejen and state councilor.

sentences.zh: 十五年，從信郡王多尼徵貴州、雲南，進二等。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he followed Prince Xin Doni in campaigning in Guizhou and Yunnan and was advanced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he joined Doni in Guizhou and Yunnan and rose one grade.

sentences.zh: 十八年，轉本旗滿洲都統。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was transferred to Manchu commander-in-chief of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he became Manchu commander-in-chief of the banner.

sentences.zh: 康熙十一年，卒，諡襄壯。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Kangxi he died; posthumous title Xiangzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 11 with posthumous name Xiangzhuang.

sentences.zh: 瑪沁，博爾晉孫。

translations.literal: Maqin was Bo'erjin's grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Maqin was Bo'erjin's grandson.

sentences.zh: 父本託輝，博爾晉長子。

translations.literal: His father Bentohui was Bo'erjin's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bentohui was Bo'erjin's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 官牛錄額真，兼都察院理事官。

translations.literal: He served as niru ejen and concurrently supervising officer of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: He was niru ejen and a censorate officer.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，以擺牙喇甲喇章京從貝勒岳託伐明，自牆子嶺入邊，明薊遼總督吳阿衡以馬步兵六千來援，瑪沁與勞薩等率兵擊敗之，獲其馬及砲。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde, as bayara jalan janggin he followed Beile Yoto against the Ming, entering the frontier from Qiangzileng; Ming Ji-Liao Governor Wu Aheng came with six thousand horse and foot to relieve; Maqin with Laosa and others led troops to defeat them and captured their horses and cannon.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3, as bayara jalan janggin, he followed Yoto through Qiangzileng; Wu Aheng brought six thousand men; Maqin and Laosa routed them and took horses and guns.

sentences.zh: 六年，從圍錦州，敗敵於松山。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed the siege of Jinzhou and defeated the enemy at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year at Jinzhou he beat the foe at Songshan.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，破流賊，授牛錄章京世職。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he followed the entry through the passes, broke the roving bandits, and was granted the hereditary office of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he crossed the passes, broke the rebels, and received niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢鑲紅旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to vice commander-in-chief of the Mongol Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he became Mongol vice commander-in-chief of the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 七年，恩詔加半個前程。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, on an imperial grace amnesty, he was given half a frontier honor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year an imperial grace amnesty gave him half a frontier honor.

sentences.zh: 尋從鄭親王濟爾哈朗徵湖廣，至衡州，疾，卒。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Prince Zheng Jirhala in campaigning in Huguang; at Hengzhou he fell ill and died.
translations.idiomatic: He soon joined Prince Zheng into Huguang, fell ill at Hengzhou, and died.

sentences.zh: 無子，以兄子康喀喇襲。

translations.literal: He had no son; his elder brother's son Kangkara succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Without a son, his brother's son Kangkara inherited.

sentences.zh: 順治四年，蘇尼特部騰機思與其弟騰機特叛，？

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi the Sunite chiefs Tengjisi and his brother Tengjite rebelled —
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 the Sunite Tengjisi and Tengjite rebelled —

sentences.zh: 康喀喇，博爾晉曾孫。

translations.literal: Kangkara, Bo'erjin's great-grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Kangkara was Bo'erjin's great-grandson.

sentences.zh: 初為二等侍康喀喇從豫親王多鐸帥師往討，大破之，陣斬騰機特。

translations.literal: At first he was a Second-rank guardsman; Kangkara followed Prince Yu Dodo in commanding troops to suppress them, thoroughly defeated them, and beheaded Tengjite in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He began as Second-rank guardsman; Kangkara marched with Prince Yu Dodo, crushed the rebels, and killed Tengjite on the field.

sentences.zh: 進二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Second-rank Adahafan.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to Second-rank Adahafan.

sentences.zh: 十五年，從寧南大將軍洛託徵貴州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he followed Pacifier of the South Grand General Loto in campaigning in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he joined Loto's Guizhou campaign.

sentences.zh: 康熙十年，遷護軍參領。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Kangxi he was transferred to deputy commandant of the guards.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 10 he became deputy commandant of the guards.

sentences.zh: 十二年，吳三桂反，順承郡王勒爾錦帥師討之，康喀喇將護軍從。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Wu Sangui rebelled; Prince of Success Le'erjin led troops to suppress him, and Kangkara commanded the guards in following.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 12, when Wu Sangui rose, Le'erjin led the suppression and Kangkara marched with the guards.

sentences.zh: 十三年，攻岳州，戰荊河口，戰城陵磯，破三桂將吳應麒。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he attacked Yuezhou, fought at Jinghekou and Chenglingji, and broke Wu Sangui's general Wu Yingqi.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he fought at Yuezhou, Jinghekou, and Chenglingji and routed Wu Yingqi.

sentences.zh: 十六年，攻長沙，复茶陵，戰攸縣，破三桂將王輝。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he attacked Changsha, again took Chaling, fought at You County, and broke Wu Sangui's general Wang Hui.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he struck Changsha, retook Chaling, fought at You, and defeated Wang Hui.

sentences.zh: 十七年，取耒陽，下常寧、新寧諸縣，又克郴州，康喀喇皆在行間。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he took Leiyang, reduced Changning and Xinning and other counties, and again captured Chenzhou; Kangkara was present in every action.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he took Leiyang, Changning, Xinning, and Chenzhou; Kangkara was in every fight.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，授鑲紅旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed vice commander-in-chief of the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he became Manchu vice commander-in-chief of the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，從裕親王福全徵噶爾丹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he followed Prince Yu Fuquan in campaigning against Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he joined Prince Yu Fuquan against Galdan.

sentences.zh: 三十年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the thirtieth year.

sentences.zh: 雅希禪，先世居馬佳，以地為氏。

translations.literal: Yaxishen's clan had long dwelt at Magiya and took the place as their surname.
translations.idiomatic: Yaxishen's people lived at Magiya and took the place as their clan name.

sentences.zh: 父尼瑪禪，當太祖兵初起，從其兄赫東額率五十餘戶來歸，任牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His father Nimazan, when Taizu's army was first rising, followed his elder brother Hedong'e in leading more than fifty households to submit and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His father Nimazan came in with his brother Hedong'e and fifty households when Taizu first took up arms and became niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 雅希禪事太祖，積戰功，授備禦，為扎爾固齊。

translations.literal: Yaxishen served Taizu, accumulated battle merit, was appointed beiyu, and served as jaruguci.
translations.idiomatic: Yaxishen served Taizu, won honors in battle, became beiyu and jaruguci.

sentences.zh: 天命四年，蒙古喀爾喀五部遣使請盟，太祖命額剋星格、綽護爾、雅希禪、庫爾纏、希福往蒞。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianming the five Khalkha Mongol tribes sent envoys requesting alliance; Taizu ordered Ekeixingge, Chuohu'er, Yaxishen, Ku'ercan, and Xifu to go and preside.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 4 the five Khalkha tribes sought alliance; Taizu sent Ekeixingge, Chuohu'er, Yaxishen, Ku'ercan, and Xifu to treat with them.

sentences.zh: 是歲，從上御明師，戰於界凡，雅希禪先眾克敵，复擊明總兵馬林于尚間崖，破其中堅，以功進二等參將。

translations.literal: That year he followed the khan in meeting the Ming army at Jiefan; Yaxishen was first among the host to defeat the enemy; again he struck Ming Commander Ma Lin at Shangjianya, broke his center, and for merit was advanced to Second-rank assistant general.
translations.idiomatic: That year at Jiefan Yaxishen beat the foe first, then shattered Ma Lin's center at Shangjianya and rose to Second-rank assistant general.

sentences.zh: 七年，從上克遼陽，進三等副將。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed the khan in taking Liaoyang and was advanced to Third-rank deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he helped take Liaoyang and became Third-rank deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 及沙嶺之戰，為敵所創，戰敗，降一等參將。

translations.literal: At the battle of Shaling he was wounded by the enemy, the battle was lost, and he was reduced one grade to First-rank assistant general.
translations.idiomatic: At Shaling he was wounded in defeat and dropped to First-rank assistant general.

sentences.zh: 八年，從貝勒阿巴泰等伐扎魯特部，與達音布、博爾晉率兵逼貝勒昂安寨，昂安以其孥行，達音布戰死，雅希禪與博爾晉共擊殺昂安。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed Beile Abatai and others in campaigning against the Zhalut tribe; with Dayinbu and Bo'erjin he led troops against Beile Ang'an's stockade; Ang'an fled with his family; Dayinbu died in battle; Yaxishen and Bo'erjin pressed forward together and killed Ang'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year against the Zhalut, Dayinbu fell and Yaxishen with Bo'erjin killed Ang'an.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after.

sentences.zh: 順治十二年，世祖追錄太祖、太宗諸將，賜諡勒碑，雅希禪諡敏果。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Shunzhi the Shizu Emperor recorded the generals of Taizu and Hong Taiji, granted posthumous titles and steles; Yaxishen's posthumous title was Minguo.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 12 the court honored Taizu and Hong Taiji's generals; Yaxishen was posthumously named Minguo.

sentences.zh: 子三：恭袞、訥爾特、拉篤渾。

translations.literal: He had three sons: Gonggun, Ni'erte, and Laduhun.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Gonggun, Ni'erte, and Laduhun.

sentences.zh: 恭袞襲職，坐事，析世職為二備禦，與其弟訥爾特分襲。

translations.literal: Gonggun inherited the office but was punished; the hereditary rank was split into two beiyu shares divided between him and his younger brother Ni'erte.
translations.idiomatic: Gonggun inherited but was punished; the rank was split between him and Ni'erte as two beiyu.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，授刑部副理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he was appointed vice supervising officer of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 he became vice officer of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 四年，從伐索倫，陣沒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed the campaign against the Solon and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died fighting the Solon.

sentences.zh: 部議恭袞不從軍令，乃為敵所戕，當奪世職，籍家產三之一，上念其父雅希禪有功，特貰之。

translations.literal: The ministry held that Gonggun had not obeyed military orders and was therefore killed by the enemy; his hereditary office should be forfeited and one-third of his household property registered; the khan, mindful of his father Yaxishen's merit, specially pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry would have stripped Gonggun for disobedience, but the khan pardoned him for Yaxishen's sake.

sentences.zh: 訥爾特，初從太宗伐明，敗敵小凌河。

translations.literal: Ni'erte at first followed Hong Taiji against the Ming and defeated the enemy at Xiaolinghe.
translations.idiomatic: Ni'erte first fought the Ming with Hong Taiji and won at Xiaolinghe.

sentences.zh: 復自大同入邊，選善射者使訥爾特將之，攻克小石城。

translations.literal: Again he entered the frontier from Datong; skilled archers were chosen and placed under Ni'erte's command; he took Xiaoshicheng.
translations.idiomatic: He entered from Datong, led picked archers, and took Xiaoshicheng.

sentences.zh: 既，襲備禦。

translations.literal: Thereafter he inherited beiyu.
translations.idiomatic: He then inherited beiyu.

sentences.zh: 復從圍錦州，屢敗敵松山、杏山。

translations.literal: Again he followed the siege of Jinzhou and repeatedly defeated the enemy at Songshan and Xingshan.
translations.idiomatic: At Jinzhou he repeatedly beat the foe at Songshan and Xingshan.

sentences.zh: 崇德七年，授刑部參政，兼梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chongde he was appointed vice minister of the Board of Punishments and concurrently meiren ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 7 he became punishments vice minister and meiren ejen.

sentences.zh: 師方攻松山，松山明兵夜遁，訥爾特與擺牙喇纛章京鰲拜，馳塔山南海濱，先敵至，蓐食以待。

translations.literal: While the army was attacking Songshan, Ming troops fled by night; Ni'erte and bayara banner janggin Oboi galloped to Tashan on the southern seashore, reached the enemy first, and waited after a hasty meal.
translations.idiomatic: During the Songshan siege Ni'erte and Oboi raced to the southern shore, overtook the fleeing Ming, and lay in wait.

sentences.zh: 夜擊明兵，達旦，明兵據山巔，訥爾特率所部冒矢石仰攻，明兵敗走，乘勝逐之，明。

translations.literal: By night they struck the Ming army until dawn; the Ming troops held the hilltop; Ni'erte led his command up under arrow and stone fire; the Ming army was defeated and fled; pressing the victory in pursuit —
translations.idiomatic: They attacked through the night; when the Ming held the heights Ni'erte stormed uphill under fire and drove them off —

sentences.zh: 八年，從伐明，初入邊，擊敗明守將。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed the campaign against the Ming; on first entering the frontier he defeated the Ming defending commanders.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he entered the frontier and beat the Ming defenders.

sentences.zh: 師渡渾河，方築梁，明兵千餘起撓？

translations.literal: When the army crossed the Hun River and was building a bridge, more than a thousand Ming troops rose to harass —
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Hun, as a bridge was being built, a thousand Ming troops harassed them —

sentences.zh: 兵入水死者甚之，訥爾特擊之走。

translations.literal: many soldiers drowned in the water; Ni'erte struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: many men drowned; Ni'erte drove the enemy away.

sentences.zh: 复敗明援兵於三河，進略山東，克武定。

translations.literal: Again he defeated Ming relief at Sanhe, advanced into Shandong, and took Wuding.
translations.idiomatic: He routed Ming relief at Sanhe, raided Shandong, and took Wuding.

sentences.zh: 師還，將出邊，明將以步兵追躡，謀劫砲，訥爾特與固山額真準塔還擊，破之，賜白金五百。

translations.literal: When the army returned and was about to leave the frontier, Ming generals pursued on foot intending to seize the cannon; Ni'erte with Gushan Ejen Zhuntai turned and struck, broke them, and was given five hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: On the return Ming foot soldiers tried to seize the guns; Ni'erte and Zhuntai beat them back and he received five hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 九月，復從鄭親王濟爾哈朗伐明，攻寧遠，明總兵吳三桂出拒，訥爾特力戰，陣沒，贈游擊。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he again followed Prince Zheng Jirhala against the Ming and attacked Ningyuan; Ming Commander Wu Sangui came out to resist; Ni'erte fought fiercely and died in battle; he was posthumously granted guerrilla officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month at Ningyuan he fought Wu Sangui to the death and was posthumously made guerrilla officer.

sentences.zh: 拉篤渾從父兄在軍，戰比有功。

translations.literal: Laduhun followed his father and elder brothers on campaign and had merit in successive battles.
translations.idiomatic: Laduhun campaigned with his kin and won repeated honors.

sentences.zh: 恭袞戰死，襲備禦。

translations.literal: When Gonggun died in battle, he inherited beiyu.
translations.idiomatic: When Gonggun fell, he inherited beiyu.

sentences.zh: 崇德六年，從伐明，圍錦州，陣沒，加半個前程。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Chongde he followed the campaign against the Ming and besieged Jinzhou; he died in battle and was given half a frontier honor.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 6 at Jinzhou he died in battle and received half a frontier honor.

sentences.zh: 舒賽，世居薩克達，以地為氏。

translations.literal: Shusai's clan had long dwelt at Sakda and took the place as their surname.
translations.idiomatic: Shusai's people lived at Sakda and took the place as their clan.

sentences.zh: 歸太祖，隸滿洲鑲藍旗。

translations.literal: He submitted to Taizu and was enrolled in the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He came to Taizu and entered the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 天命四年，從太祖禦明師，進二等參將。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianming he followed Taizu in meeting the Ming army and was advanced to Second-rank assistant general.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 4 he met the Ming army with Taizu and became Second-rank assistant general.

sentences.zh: 太宗即？

translations.literal: When Hong Taiji —
translations.idiomatic: When Hong Taiji —

sentences.zh: 與雅希禪等攻馬林于尚間崖，以功授備禦。

translations.literal: with Yaxishen and others attacked Ma Lin at Shangjianya; for merit he was appointed beiyu.
translations.idiomatic: with Yaxishen he fought Ma Lin at Shangjianya and was made beiyu.

sentences.zh: 尋從伐瓦爾喀，俘獲甚位，列十六大臣，佐鑲藍旗。

translations.literal: Soon he followed a campaign against Walgiya; captures were very many; he was listed among the sixteen great ministers assisting the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned in Walgiya with rich spoils and became one of sixteen great ministers for the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年，從伐朝鮮，師還，命與固山額真阿山等帥師戍義州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong he followed the campaign against Korea; when the army returned he was ordered, together with Gushan Ejen Ashan and others, to command troops garrisoned at Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 1 he invaded Korea, then garrisoned Yizhou with Ashan.

sentences.zh: 八年，上自將伐明，鄭親王濟爾哈朗居守，舒賽與梅勒額真蒙阿圖等副之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the khan personally led a campaign against the Ming; Prince Zheng Jirhala remained to guard the capital; Shusai with Meiren Ejen Meng'atu and others assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Hong Taiji marched on the Ming while Jirhala held the capital; Shusai assisted Meng'atu.

sentences.zh: 舒賽善戰，攻城輒被棉甲先登，太祖嘉其勇，又慮其輕進，溫諭誡止之。

translations.literal: Shusai was skilled in battle; whenever a city was attacked he would put on cotton armor and be first to ascend; Taizu praised his courage yet also feared his rash advance and gently admonished him to stop.
translations.idiomatic: Shusai always led the escalade in cotton armor; Taizu praised his valor but warned him against recklessness.

sentences.zh: 舒賽益感奮，先後克十六城。

translations.literal: Shusai was all the more stirred to zeal; before and after he took sixteen cities.
translations.idiomatic: Stirred all the more, he helped take sixteen cities.

sentences.zh: 太宗特敕旌其功，進三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: Hong Taiji specially decreed commendation of his merit and advanced him to Third-rank meiren janggin.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Taiji commended him and made him Third-rank meiren janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德六年十月，卒。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the sixth year of Chongde he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the tenth month of Chongde 6.

sentences.zh: 順治十二年，追諡壯敏。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Shunzhi he was posthumously titled Zhuangmin.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 12 he received the posthumous name Zhuangmin.

sentences.zh: 子西蘭，初任牛錄章京，授備禦世職。

translations.literal: His son Xilan at first served as niru janggin and was granted the hereditary office of beiyu.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xilan began as niru janggin and inherited beiyu.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，以擺牙喇甲喇章京從豫親王多鐸討李自成，攻潼關，三戰皆勝。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, as bayara jalan janggin, he followed Prince Yu Dodo in suppressing Li Zicheng, attacked Tongguan, and three battles were all won.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he followed Dodo against Li Zicheng, stormed Tongguan three times, and won each fight.

sentences.zh: 二年，從貝勒博洛定江南，下松江，徇福建，克平和。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Beile Bolo in pacifying Jiangnan, took Songjiang, marched into Fujian, and captured Pinghe.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year with Bolo he pacified the south, took Songjiang, entered Fujian, and captured Pinghe.

sentences.zh: 論功，遇恩詔，進三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: For merit, on an imperial grace amnesty, he was advanced to Third-rank Adahafan.
translations.idiomatic: Merit and an imperial grace amnesty raised him to Third-rank Adahafan.

sentences.zh: 七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventh year.

sentences.zh: 西蘭子席特庫，崇德六年，襲大父舒賽世職三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: Xilan's son Xitekui in the sixth year of Chongde inherited his grandfather Shusai's hereditary office of Third-rank meiren janggin.
translations.idiomatic: Xilan's son Xitekui in Chongde 6 inherited Shusai's Third-rank meiren janggin.

sentences.zh: 八年，授甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he became jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 從伐，以砲克城，斬明總兵李輔明。

translations.literal: He followed a campaign and, using cannon, took a city and beheaded Ming Commander Li Fuming.
translations.idiomatic: On campaign he took a city by cannon and beheaded Ming Commander Li Fuming.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，進略山西，佐固山額真葉臣？

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he followed the entry through the passes, advanced into Shanxi, and assisted Gushan Ejen Yechen —
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he crossed the passes into Shanxi and assisted Yechen —

sentences.zh: 明，攻前屯等克太原。

translations.literal: against the Ming, attacked Qiantun and others, and took Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: against the Ming, took Qiantun and other posts, and captured Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 二年，從英親王阿濟格徇陝西，敗賊延安。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Prince Ying Ajige in pacifying Shaanxi and defeated the bandits at Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he joined Prince Ying Ajige in Shaanxi and routed the rebels at Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 自成走湖廣，躡擊至安陸，與鰲拜等屢破敵，進二等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: Li Zicheng fled to Huguang; pursuing to Anlu, together with Oboi and others he repeatedly broke the enemy and was advanced to Second-rank meiren janggin.
translations.idiomatic: Chasing Li Zicheng to Anlu, he and Oboi repeatedly defeated the foe and rose to Second-rank meiren janggin.

sentences.zh: 四年，改二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was changed to Second-rank Ashaniyahan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he became Second-rank Ashaniyahan.

sentences.zh: 五年四月，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fifth month of the fifth year.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，定封二等男。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong period the fief was fixed as Second-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong the rank was fixed as Second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 景固勒岱，扎庫塔氏。

translations.literal: Jingguledai was of the Zhakuta clan.
translations.idiomatic: Jingguledai belonged to the Zhakuta clan.

sentences.zh: 初居呼爾哈部，烏喇招之，不往。

translations.literal: He first dwelt in the Hurka tribe; Ula summoned him but he would not go.
translations.idiomatic: He lived first among the Hurka; Ula called him but he refused.

sentences.zh: 太祖遣將伐東海渥集部，景。

translations.literal: Taizu sent generals to campaign against the eastern Woji tribe; Jingguledai —
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu sent generals against the eastern Woji, Jingguledai —

sentences.zh: 尋挈孥及諸兄弟率所屬三十戶來歸，隸滿洲？

translations.literal: soon brought his wife and children and all his brothers, leading the thirty households under his command to submit; he was enrolled in the Manchu —
translations.idiomatic: soon brought wife, children, brothers, and thirty households to submit and entered the Manchu —

sentences.zh: 固勒岱徒步從軍，攻取烏爾固宸路，俘馘甚正白旗，任牛錄額真。

translations.literal: Jingguledai marched on foot with the army, took the Wulgu Chen route, and captures were very many; in the Plain White Banner he was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He marched on foot, took the Wulgu Chen route with rich spoils, and became niru ejen in the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 天命三年，從上伐明，入鴉鶻關，攻克清河城，擢甲喇額真，仍兼領牛錄。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianming he followed the khan in campaigning against the Ming, entered Yahuguan, stormed and took Qinghe city, was promoted to jalan ejen, and still concurrently headed his niru.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 3 he entered Yahuguan, took Qinghe, became jalan ejen, and kept his niru.

sentences.zh: 上規取遼、瀋，景固勒岱並在軍有功。

translations.literal: When the khan planned to take Liao and Shen, Jingguledai was in the army throughout with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaigns for Liaodong and Shenyang he served with merit throughout.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年五月，授世職二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year of Tiancong he was granted the hereditary office of Second-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Tiancong 8 he received Second-rank jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 十二月，命與甲喇額真吳巴海率兵四千伐瓦爾喀部，降其屯長芬達里及所屬五百餘戶，俘阿庫里尼滿部千餘人，獲貂、虎、狐、貉、猞猁猻、獺、青鼠諸毛毳之屬。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was ordered, together with Jalan Ejen Wubahai, to lead four thousand men against the Walgiya tribe; they reduced the tunzhang Fendali and more than five hundred households under him, captured more than a thousand of the Akurini Man tribe, and obtained sable, tiger, fox, raccoon dog, lynx, otter, and blue rat furs and pelts of every sort.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he and Wubahai led four thousand men against Walgiya, took Fendali's five hundred households, a thousand Akurini Manchu captives, and great hauls of furs.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，師還，上令禮部諸臣宴勞，以所獲分賚將士，進世職一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year, when the army returned, the khan ordered ministers of the Board of Rites to feast and reward them; the captures were distributed to officers and soldiers; he was advanced to First-rank hereditary jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the ninth year the court feasted the army, shared the spoils, and raised him to First-rank jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，從武英郡王阿濟格攻明皮島，克之，賚裘服、鞍、馬、銀、布、駝、牛諸物。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde he followed Prince Ying Ajige in attacking the Ming Pidao, took it, and was given fur coats, saddles, horses, silver, cloth, camels, cattle, and other goods.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 he followed Ajige, took Ming Pidao, and received furs, horses, silver, cloth, camels, and cattle.

sentences.zh: 順治初，恩詔，累進二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi, on imperial grace amnesties, he was repeatedly advanced to Second-rank Ashaniyahan.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi, on grace amnesties, he rose to Second-rank Ashaniyahan.

sentences.zh: 十一年八月，卒，諡忠直。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eleventh year he died; posthumous title Zhongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eleventh month of the eleventh year with posthumous name Zhongzhi.

sentences.zh: 從弟崇阿，任牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His younger cousin Chong'a served as niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His cousin Chong'a was niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，從伐明，徇大同，略回雁堡。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong he followed the campaign against the Ming, raided Datong, and took Huiyan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 he raided Datong and took Huiyan Fort.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從伐朝鮮，敗敵桃山村。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed the campaign against Korea and defeated the enemy at Taoshan Village.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he fought Korea and beat the foe at Taoshan.

sentences.zh: 六年，從伐明，圍錦州，入其郛，巷戰。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed the campaign against the Ming, besieged Jinzhou, entered the outer wall, and fought in the lanes.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year at Jinzhou he entered the suburbs and fought street to street.

sentences.zh: 七年，從伐明，敗敵渾河之濱，入山東，至壽光。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed the campaign against the Ming, defeated the enemy on the banks of the Hun River, entered Shandong, and reached Shouguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he beat the foe on the Hun, entered Shandong, and reached Shouguang.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he followed the entry through the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he crossed the passes.

sentences.zh: 二年，從下浙江，拔湖州，進取福建，敗敵福寧。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed the reduction of Zhejiang, took Huzhou, advanced into Fujian, and defeated the enemy at Funing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he took Huzhou, entered Fujian, and beat the foe at Funing.

sentences.zh: 五年，從討金聲桓，敗王得仁於南昌。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed the suppression of Jin Shenghuan and defeated Wang Deren at Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year against Jin Shenghuan he routed Wang Deren at Nanchang.

sentences.zh: 從討李成棟，破其軍，六年，戰南康，圍信豐，蹙成棟赴水死。

translations.literal: He followed the suppression of Li Chengdong, broke his army; in the sixth year he fought at Nankang, besieged Xinfeng, and pressed Chengdong until he drowned himself.
translations.idiomatic: Against Li Chengdong he broke their force; in the sixth year at Xinfeng he drove Chengdong into the water to his death.

sentences.zh: 累功，遇恩詔，進一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: For accumulated merit, on an imperial grace amnesty, he was advanced to First-rank Adahafan.
translations.idiomatic: Merit and grace amnesty raised him to First-rank Adahafan.

sentences.zh: 十八年，卒。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighteenth year.

sentences.zh: 揚善，瓜爾佳氏，費英東弟音達戶齊之子也。

translations.literal: Yangshan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was the son of Feiyongdong's younger brother Yindahuqi.
translations.idiomatic: Yangshan of the Guwalgiya line was Yindahuqi's son; Yindahuqi was Feiyongdong's brother.

sentences.zh: 費英東諸弟：音達戶齊、吳爾漢、郎格齊，皆事太祖，隸鑲黃旗；

translations.literal: Feiyongdong's younger brothers Yindahuqi, Wu'erhan, and Langgeqi all served Taizu and belonged to the Bordered Yellow Banner;
translations.idiomatic: Feiyongdong's brothers Yindahuqi, Wu'erhan, and Langgeqi served Taizu in the Bordered Yellow Banner;

sentences.zh: 而音達戶齊諸子：揚善、伊遜、鍾金、吉賽、納都祜、吉遜？

translations.literal: while Yindahuqi's sons Yangshan, Yisun, Zhongjin, Jisai, Naduhu, and Jisun —
translations.idiomatic: Yindahuqi's sons were Yangshan, Yisun, Zhongjin, Jisai, Naduhu, and Jisun —

sentences.zh: 、，改隸鑲白旗。

translations.literal: — were transferred to the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: — and were later moved to the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 揚善亦逮事太祖，授備禦。

translations.literal: Yangshan also attended on Taizu in his youth and was appointed beiyu.
translations.idiomatic: Yangshan grew up in Taizu's service and became beiyu.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，旗設調遣大臣二，揚善佐鑲黃旗，尋授巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: When Hong Taiji acceded, two dispatch ministers were appointed for each banner; Yangshan assisted the Bordered Yellow Banner and soon was appointed bayara banner janggin.
translations.idiomatic: At Hong Taiji's accession he assisted the Bordered Yellow Banner and became bayara banner janggin.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，從伐明，受上方略，衝鋒攻堅，所至有功。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong he followed the campaign against the Ming, received the khan's strategy, charged in assaults on strong places, and everywhere had merit.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 3 he took the khan's plan, stormed strongpoints, and won honors everywhere.

sentences.zh: 五年，攻大凌河，與明監軍道張春戰，冒矢石陷陣，胸腕皆被創，進游擊，擢內大臣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he attacked Dalinhe and fought Grand Coordinator Zhang Chun; braving arrow and stone he broke into the formation; chest and wrists were all wounded; he was advanced to guerrilla officer and promoted to inner minister.
translations.idiomatic: At Dalinhe he fought Zhang Chun through arrow storm, took wounds on chest and arms, and rose to inner minister.

sentences.zh: 六年，從伐察哈爾，林丹汗既遁有遁入明境沙河堡者，使揚善齎書索以歸。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed the campaign against the Chakhar; after Lindan Khan had fled, some fled into Ming territory at Shahe Fort; Yangshan was sent with a letter demanding their return.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year against the Chakhar he demanded fugitives in Shahe Fort from the Ming.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，略大同，蒙古有被掠者，悉？

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde he raided Datong; Mongols who had been carried off —
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 on the Datong raid, Mongols who had been seized —

sentences.zh: ，其部取以還，授議政大臣。

translations.literal: his command took them all back; he was appointed councilor of state.
translations.idiomatic: were all recovered by his command; he became councilor of state.

sentences.zh: 順治初，肅親王豪格得罪，都統何洛會誣告揚善及其子羅碩諂附豪格為亂。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi, when Prince Su Haoge was condemned, Commander-in-Chief He Luohui falsely accused Yangshan and his son Luoshuo of fawning on Haoge and plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi, when Haoge fell, He Luohui accused Yangshan and his son Luoshuo of plotting with him.

sentences.zh: 羅碩能通滿、漢、蒙古文字，太宗召直文館，授內國史院學士、噶布什賢章京，兼刑部理事官。

translations.literal: Luoshuo could read Manchu, Chinese, and Mongolian; Hong Taiji summoned him to the Literary Hall, appointed him academician of the Inner History Academy and gabushixian janggin, and concurrently supervising officer of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Luoshuo knew all three scripts; Hong Taiji made him academy academician, gabushixian janggin, and punishments officer.

sentences.zh: 至是，父子俱棄市。

translations.literal: At this time father and son were both executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Father and son were both executed.

sentences.zh: 世祖親政，誅何洛會，复揚善世職，以其孫霍羅襲。

translations.literal: When the Shizu Emperor took power in person, He Luohui was put to death; Yangshan's hereditary office was restored and his grandson Huoluo succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor came of age, He Luohui was killed, Yangshan's rank restored, and grandson Huoluo inherited.

sentences.zh: 伊遜，音達戶齊第三子。

translations.literal: Yisun was Yindahuqi's third son.
translations.idiomatic: Yisun was Yindahuqi's third son.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，列十六大臣，佐鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: When Hong Taiji acceded, he was listed among the sixteen great ministers assisting the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: At Hong Taiji's accession he was one of sixteen great ministers for the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，從伐明，攻遵化，伊遜先登，中砲傷臂，太宗親臨視，授游擊，尋遷兵部承政。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong he followed the campaign against the Ming and attacked Zunhua; Yisun was first to ascend; struck by cannon he wounded his arm; Hong Taiji came in person to see him, appointed him guerrilla officer, and soon transferred him to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 3 at Zunhua he was first up the wall, was wounded by cannon, was seen by Hong Taiji, made guerrilla officer, then Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 七年，偕英俄爾岱使朝鮮，定互市約。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, together with Ingurdai, he was envoy to Korea and fixed the mutual-trade treaty.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he and Ingurdai went to Korea and set the trade treaty.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，坐事，罷。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde he was punished for an offense and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 he was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 三年，復為兵部承政。

translations.literal: In the third year he was again made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he returned as Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 四年，命與工部承政薩穆什喀等伐虎爾哈部，分兵循喇裡闡，下兀庫爾城，設伏鐸陳城，敗敵，斬七十級。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was ordered, together with Minister of Works Samushka and others, to campaign against the Hūrka tribe; dividing forces along Lalichan they took Wuku'er city, set an ambush at Duochen city, defeated the enemy, and beheaded seventy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he and Samushka split forces along Lalichan, took Wuku'er, ambushed at Duochen, and killed seventy.

sentences.zh: 師還，坐為博穆博果爾所襲，亡輜重、士卒，論罰。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was punished because he had been attacked by Bomboguo'er, losing baggage train, soldiers, and equipment.
translations.idiomatic: On the return he was fined after Bomboguo'er raided his train and men.

sentences.zh: 八年，卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighth year.

sentences.zh: 順治十二年，追諡襄壯，建碑紀績。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Shunzhi he was posthumously titled Xiangzhuang and a stele was erected recording his achievements.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 12 he was named Xiangzhuang and given a merit stele.

sentences.zh: 子噶達渾，孫沙爾布，相繼襲職。

translations.literal: His son Gadahun and grandson Sharbu succeeded to the office in turn.
translations.idiomatic: His son Gadahun and grandson Sharbu inherited in turn.

sentences.zh: 納都祜，音達戶齊第八子。

translations.literal: Naduhu was Yindahuqi's eighth son.
translations.idiomatic: Naduhu was Yindahuqi's eighth son.

sentences.zh: 順治初，任護軍參領。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he served as deputy commandant of the guards.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he was deputy commandant of the guards.

sentences.zh: 從入關，破李自成，克潼關，定西安。

translations.literal: He followed the entry through the passes, broke Li Zicheng, took Tongguan, and pacified Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed the passes, broke Li Zicheng, took Tongguan, and settled Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 移師下江南，追明福王至蕪湖。

translations.literal: The army shifted south into Jiangnan and pursued the Ming Prince of Fu to Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: He marched south, chasing the Ming Prince of Fu to Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 並有俘馘，授半個前程。

translations.literal: In every action there were captures and heads taken; he was granted half a frontier honor.
translations.idiomatic: He took captives and heads and received half a frontier honor.

sentences.zh: 三年，從討騰機思，土謝圖汗、碩羅汗拒戰，皆擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed the suppression of Tengjisi; the Tushitu Khan and Sholuo Khan resisted and were both defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year against Tengjisi he beat both the Tushitu and Sholuo khans.

sentences.zh: 五年，從討金聲桓，有功。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed the suppression of Jin Shenghuan with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he helped suppress Jin Shenghuan.

sentences.zh: 八年，擢正白旗梅勒額真，改副都御史，進拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was promoted to meiren ejen of the Plain White Banner, changed to vice censor-in-chief, and advanced to baitalabuleha.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he became Plain White meiren ejen, vice censor-in-chief, and baitalabuleha.

sentences.zh: 又以伊遜無嗣，納都祜當並襲，复遇恩詔，覈改一等阿思哈尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Because Yisun had no heir, Naduhu was to inherit jointly; again on an imperial grace amnesty the review changed this to First-rank Ashaniyahan concurrently with tosoroha.
translations.idiomatic: As Yisun had no son, Naduhu was to merge inheritances and rose to First-rank Ashaniyahan with tosoroha.

sentences.zh: 十四年，都察院請更定世職襲次，上疑其徇私，坐罷官。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the Censorate asked to fix the order of hereditary succession; the khan suspected partiality and dismissed him from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was cashiered when the Censorate's succession plan looked partial.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventeenth year.

sentences.zh: 無子，以鍾金孫貴欽、吉賽子盧柏赫分襲。

translations.literal: He had no son; Zhongjin's grandson Guiqin and Jisai's son Lubaihe divided the inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: Without a son, Guiqin and Lubaihe split the inheritance.

sentences.zh: 武賴，吳爾漢子也。

translations.literal: Wu Lai was Wu'erhan's son.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lai was Wu'erhan's son.

sentences.zh: 隸滿洲鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: He belonged to the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰四年，與布爾堪等將精兵百人略明邊，渡大。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tiancong, with Bulikan and others he led a hundred picked troops to raid the Ming frontier and crossed the great river.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 4 he led a hundred elite raiders across the great river into the Ming frontier.

sentences.zh: 八年，任甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he served as jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he became jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 九年，擢固山額真，領正藍旗。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was promoted to gushan ejen and headed the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he became gushan ejen of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年七月？

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Chongde —
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Chongde 1 —

sentences.zh: 凌河，馳斬俘獲甚來窺伺，盡殲之。

translations.literal: at Dalinhe he galloped to cut down those who came to spy on the captures and annihilated them all.
translations.idiomatic: at Dalinhe he rode down scouts and wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 師還，坐出邊不收後隊？

translations.literal: When the army returned he was punished for leaving the frontier without collecting the rear guard —
translations.idiomatic: On the return he was fined for not collecting the rear guard —

sentences.zh: ，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，明遵化三屯營守備率，誑言阿濟格逼脅，臨陣敗走，罰白金四百。

translations.literal: he followed Prince Ying Ajige in campaigning against the Ming; the Ming defending officer of Zunhua's Santunying led his men, falsely claiming Ajige had coerced them, and fled before battle; he was fined four hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: with Ajige against the Ming; a Zunhua officer fled claiming coercion and Wu Lai was fined four hundred taels.

sentences.zh: 十二月，上自將伐朝鮮，武賴從，與豫親王多鐸共擊敗諸道援兵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the khan personally led a campaign against Korea; Wu Lai followed and, with Prince Yu Dodo, jointly defeated relief forces on every route.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he joined the Korean campaign and with Dodo beat every relief column.

sentences.zh: 復與固山額真譚泰等率阿禮哈超哈兵攻漢城，樹雲梯以登，守陴者奔竄，盡收其輜重牲畜以歸。

translations.literal: Again, with Gushan Ejen Tantai and others, he led alihachao troops against Hanseong; cloud ladders were set to ascend; those defending the battlements fled in disorder; all baggage and livestock were taken back.
translations.idiomatic: With Tantai he stormed Hanseong by ladder, routed the defenders, and brought back all stores and herds.

sentences.zh: 三年，從貝勒岳託伐明，至山東，擊敗明內官馮永盛、總兵侯永祿等，經董家口，敵兵千餘，依山為陣，武賴與戰屢捷，？

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Beile Yoto against the Ming to Shandong and defeated Ming eunuch Feng Yongsheng, Commander Hou Yonglu, and others; passing Dongjiakou, more than a thousand enemy troops drew up in battle order on the hills; Wu Lai fought repeatedly with victory —
translations.idiomatic: In the third year in Shandong he beat Feng Yongsheng and Hou Yonglu; at Dongjiakou he fought a thousand Ming on the hills and won —

sentences.zh: 其壘。

translations.literal: their stockades.
translations.idiomatic: their camps.

sentences.zh: 明將復率兵要我軍輜重，武賴與準塔擊破之，遂乘勝行略地。

translations.literal: Ming generals again led troops to threaten our baggage train; Wu Lai with Zhuntai struck and broke them, then pressed the victory in raiding the countryside.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming troops threatened the train, Wu Lai and Zhuntai routed them and raided on.

sentences.zh: 以功，授牛錄章京。

translations.literal: For merit he was granted niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he received niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 五年，從睿親王多爾袞伐明，刈禾錦州，明兵出拒，武賴追擊，迫使入城，遂略松山。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Prince Rui Dorgon against the Ming to reap the grain at Jinzhou; Ming troops came out to resist; Wu Lai pursued, forced them into the city, then raided Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year at Jinzhou he drove Ming troops into the walls, then raided Songshan.

sentences.zh: 八年，從貝勒阿巴泰伐明，至渾河，擊敗明兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed Beile Abatai against the Ming; at the Hun River he defeated Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year at the Hun he routed the Ming.

sentences.zh: 師還，經密雲，明兵以火器斷歸路，武賴與固山額真鰲拜奮勇馳突，明兵潰走；

translations.literal: On the return, passing Miyun, Ming troops used firearms to cut the line of retreat; Wu Lai with Gushan Ejen Oboi charged fiercely; the Ming army broke and fled;
translations.idiomatic: Returning through Miyun, when Ming firelocks blocked the road, he and Oboi charged through;

sentences.zh: 度塞，复敗敵，整軍出邊。

translations.literal: crossing the pass, again defeated the enemy, and re-formed the army to leave the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: they beat the foe again beyond the pass and marched out in order.

sentences.zh: 以功加半個前程。

translations.literal: For merit he was given half a frontier honor.
translations.idiomatic: He received half a frontier honor.

sentences.zh: 順治初，入關破李自成，三詔，進至一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he entered the passes and broke Li Zicheng; on three imperial grace amnesties he was advanced to First-rank Ashaniyahan.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he broke Li Zicheng and, on three grace amnesties, rose to First-rank Ashaniyahan.

sentences.zh: 以老乞休。

translations.literal: Citing age, he begged to retire.
translations.idiomatic: He retired for age.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，諡康毅，建碑紀績。

translations.literal: Soon he died; posthumous title Kangyi; a stele was erected recording his achievements.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after with posthumous name Kangyi and a merit stele.

sentences.zh: 齊子鰲拜，郎格孫席卜臣，皆別有傳。

translations.literal: His son Oboi and Langge's grandson Xibuchen both have separate biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His son Oboi and Xibuchen have separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 冷格里，舒穆祿氏，滿洲正黃旗人，揚古利弟也。

translations.literal: Lenggeri, of the Šumulu clan, was a man of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner and Yangguli's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Lenggeri of the Šumulu clan, Plain Yellow Banner, was Yangguli's brother.

sentences.zh: 少事太祖，從征伐。

translations.literal: In youth he served Taizu and followed the campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: He served Taizu from youth on campaign.

sentences.zh: 功，自備禦累進一等副將。

translations.literal: for merit he was repeatedly advanced from beiyu to First-rank deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: for merit he rose from beiyu to First-rank deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 明將毛文龍分兵自朝鮮義州城西渡鴨綠江，入海島中，闢田以耕。

translations.literal: Ming Commander Mao Wenlong divided his forces from Yizhou in Korea, crossed the Yalu west of the city, and entered an island in the sea, opening fields to farm.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Wenlong crossed from Korean Yizhou to island farms in the sea.

sentences.zh: 天命九年秋八月，上命冷格里將左翼兵、吳善將右翼兵襲擊之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the ninth year of Tianming the khan ordered Lenggeri to command the left-wing troops and Wu Shan the right-wing troops in a surprise attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Tianming 9 Taizu sent Lenggeri on the left and Wu Shan on the right against Mao Wenlong.

sentences.zh: 道得諜，知明兵晝渡江穫於島，夜還屯江岸。

translations.literal: On the way they captured a spy and learned the Ming troops crossed the river by day to harvest on the island and at night returned to camp on the riverbank.
translations.idiomatic: Spies told them the Ming crossed by day to harvest and camped on the bank at night.

sentences.zh: 冷格里夜引兵自山蹊潛行，平旦，度明兵已渡江，即疾馳，揭支流以濟。

translations.literal: Lenggeri by night led troops along a mountain path in secret; at daybreak, judging the Ming had already crossed, he galloped swiftly, forded a branch stream, and crossed.
translations.idiomatic: Lenggeri stole along a mountain path at night, forded a stream at dawn, and crossed after the Ming.

sentences.zh: 入島，爭舟，多墮水死，焚島中積聚而還。

translations.literal: Entering the island, they fought for boats; many fell into the water and died; the stores piled on the island were burned, and they returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the island men fought for boats, many drowned, and he burned the stores.

sentences.zh: 明將卒皆驚，奔潰，追斬五百餘級，餘

translations.literal: Ming officers and soldiers were all alarmed, broke and fled; more than five hundred were pursued and beheaded; the remainder —
translations.idiomatic: The Ming panicked and fled; over five hundred were cut down; the rest —

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，以其弟納穆泰為八大臣領本旗，而冷格里列十六大臣佐之。
